title: Cosmic Octopus Overlords
description: Three men in ornate royal robes and crowns stand on a glossy black stage holding glowing scepters, looking up at a giant pink octopus with yellow eyes and lightning bolts inside a massive dripping cosmic bubble filled with stars, planets, and smaller figures on a staircase. The surreal scene features a vibrant space background with constellations and spotlights illuminating the theatrical setting.
prompt: Three kings in elaborate white gold purple and red fur-lined royal robes and crowns stand on a reflective black runway stage holding glowing scepters, gazing upward at a giant vibrant pink octopus creature with large yellow eyes and electric lightning bolts emerging from a massive transparent cosmic bubble that drips colorful paint. Inside the bubble are smaller human figures on a staircase with planets stars and nebulae, set against a pink and purple space background filled with glowing constellations, theatrical spotlights from below, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene
